
```{r setup, include = TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
conf <- config::get()
```

```{r}
matched_dataset <- read.csv(here("data/processed/converter_dataset_matched.csv")) %>%
                      mutate(
                        sex = as.factor(sex),
                        scanner = as.factor(scanner),
                        group = as.factor(group),
                        site = as.factor(case_when(
                            str_starts(scanner, "macs_mr") ~ "macs_mr",
                            scanner == "macs_ms" ~ "macs_ms",
                            scanner == "bidirect" ~ "bd_ms",
                            scanner == "mnc_old_philips" ~ "mnc",
                            TRUE ~ NA_character_
                        ))
                      )

unmatched_dataset <- read.csv(here("data/processed/converter_dataset_trimmed_con.csv")) %>%
                      filter(
                        !is.na(brain_age),
                        !is.na(sex),
                        (scanner %in% matched_dataset$scanner)
                      ) %>%
                      mutate(
                        sex = as.factor(sex),
                        scanner = as.factor(scanner),
                        group = as.factor(group),
                        site = as.factor(case_when(
                            str_starts(scanner, "macs_mr") ~ "macs_mr",
                            scanner == "macs_ms" ~ "macs_ms",
                            scanner == "bidirect" ~ "bd_ms",
                            scanner == "mnc_old_philips" ~ "mnc",
                            TRUE ~ NA_character_
                        ))
                      )

unmatched_hc_data <- unmatched_dataset %>%
                      filter(
                        group == "HC" &
                        !is.na(chronological_age) &
                        !(subject_id %in% (matched_dataset %>% pull(subject_id)))
                      )

correct_age_bias <- function(.data, healthy_reference) {
  bias_model <- lm(
    BAG ~ poly(chronological_age, 2),
    data = healthy_reference
  )

  corrected_dataset <- .data %>%
    mutate(
      expected_bias = predict(bias_model, newdata = {{.data}}),
      BAG_corrected = BAG - expected_bias
    ) %>%
    select(-expected_bias)

    return (corrected_dataset)
}

print_mae <- function(.data) {
  mae <- .data %>%
    summarise(
      mae_raw = mean(abs(BAG), na.rm = TRUE),
      mae_corrected = mean(abs(BAG_corrected), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  print(mae)
}
```

```{r}
corrected_mnc_macs <- correct_age_bias(
  (matched_dataset %>% filter(cohort %in% c('macs', 'mnc'))),
  (unmatched_hc_data %>% filter(cohort %in% c('macs', 'mnc')))
)
```
```{r}
corrected_bidirect <- correct_age_bias(
  (matched_dataset %>% filter(cohort == "bidirect")),
  (unmatched_hc_data %>% filter(cohort == "bidirect"))
)
```

```{r}
cat("MAE mnc+macs\n")
corrected_mnc_macs %>% filter(group == "HC") %>% print_mae()
cat("MAE bidirect\n")
corrected_bidirect %>% filter(group == "HC") %>% print_mae()
```

```{r}
write.table(bind_rows(corrected_mnc_macs, corrected_bidirect),
            file = here("data/processed/converter_dataset_matched_corrected.csv"),
            sep = ",", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE
)
```
